title: spermacoce phalloides
intro: Spermacoce phalloides, commonly known as poison frog's meat or poison beak grass, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce phalloides are attributed to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
